title: Control Flow, Arrays, and Iteration
summary: Write boundary-safe conditions and loops while using indexed arrays, associative arrays, foreach, match, and predictable comparison.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Control Flow, Arrays, and Iteration
Verify contracts with lint, runtime, and test evidence
prerequisiteConcepts: Ability to create and save a text file

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Use `if` chains for ranges and `match` for exact value-to-result mapping. Unlike `switch`, match uses strict comparison, returns a value, and must handle unmatched input. PHP arrays serve as ordered maps and can use integer or string keys. `foreach` can iterate keys and values; avoid reference iteration unless mutation is intentional, and unset the reference afterward to prevent accidental later writes. Functions such as `array_map` and `array_filter` are useful when callbacks remain clear. Test every threshold below, at, and above.
keyPoints: Use `if` chains for ranges and `match` for exact value-to-result mapping.
commonMistakes: null should not replace every error case
